<thought>Based on the mapped reaction for template 1914391, the two reactant (precursor) SMILES obtained by removing the atom‑mapping numbers are:
1. CCOC(=O)CC1CC(O)C(C)C(C=O)O1  
2. C[C](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC  

These correspond to the two possible precursors when the template is applied to the target molecule. The required output format is a list containing a single inner list with these two SMILES strings.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"CCOC(=O)CC1CC(O)C(C)C(C=O)O1\", \"C[C](P(=O)(OCC(F)(F)F)OCC(F)(F)F)C#COC\"]]</final_answer>
